integrity.computational_evidence: standalone exact finite cross-checks; not infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Only indexed binary single-deletion reads and two-read graph confusability are covered.
The result counts edges and fixed-weight degrees; exact independence numbers at arbitrary weight are not claimed.
The limit is for the mean degree at a source weight fraction tending to a fixed interior density.
An equivalent unindexed historical calculation has not been ruled out.
title: Composition-refined degree and edge spectrum of the binary two-read deletion graph
